text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important area is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can read texts in different languages more easily. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. This is helpful for companies that want to know how customers feel. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with people in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and more helpful.
